signals.name: Analyst-revision momentum
signals.desc: When analysts upgrade a name (net buy-rating rises month/month), does it beat drift next month? Finnhub recommendation trends + forward return.

signals.name: Price momentum (3mo → 1mo)
signals.desc: Classic momentum factor: do the strongest-trending names (top third by trailing 3-month return) outperform next month?

note: These two signals need deep history so they are computed here from real Yahoo daily closes + worker recommendation trends. The brain TA + confluence rows on the page are pulled LIVE from the worker. Bar is always beat-drift, never beat-a-coin-flip.
